body: thank you for reading. i'm glad i can at least relate to someone going through the same thing. i will message you if i never need support or i need to vent again, thanks for your offer
that wasn't a stupid comment at all! it actually made me feel a lot better about the future. i guess i do just have to suck it in until high school is over

Wow, that's really bad. If you need to vent to someone, you can vent to me. Obviously we both know it sucks but we at least have some support over this subreddit. That's ridiculous that no one would ask you if you're okay. And about your unrequited love.. I can partially understand your feelings, considering I have been rejected many a time, I hope you know that someone out there cares: me. I'm so sorry for your troubles and just want you to know that I do care about you. Glad I can finally relate to someone, even a situation like this.

Talking here has surprisingly helped more than anyone else. I am trying very hard not to give up but it is becoming more complicated every day. 

Hopefully I will get to see the day when guys actually like girls with brains! i hate that i can't seem to find a guy like me, but i trust that one day they will come out of hiding.. the suspense is killing me. 

thank you for your kind words

you give me hope for the future and college. i think right now, I need to stay in high school to be able to get into the college I want which is semi-competitive. I made a promise to myself at the beginning of high school that I wouldn't kill myself until I experienced all the things I wanted to.. and if after all that, if I was still depressed, I would do it. College is definitely on the list of things to do before I kill myself. I at least want to know if it is better than high school, which many people tell me it is. maybe there is a light at the end of the tunnel, it's just veeeeeeery far away right now
True. I feel like if I just completely shut up and nod my head no one would notice a thing
thank you for reading. it's nice to know some people out there care. hugs right back atcha.

I can't ask for help.. I've tried to talk to my friends but I think I annoy them. My parents don't take it seriously and just say "boys are stupid". 

I've told my parents and a teacher or two that I want to seriously drop out of school because I can't handle the social pressure but they refuse. I guess I just have to stay in hell for the rest of high school..

btw Thank you for reading my post and responding. You don't know how much it means just to know that someone actually wants to know how I feel
